name: Appllama
description: Appllama is the design library of the highest grossing mobile apps: their screens, flows, onboarding and paywalls, with revenue context. The platform serves founders, designers and product teams across the world to help them design apps people love to use.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Appllama to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Appllama to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.appllama.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Appllama MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appllama provides these MCP tools: get_app, get_board, get_credits, get_element_screens, get_flow_apps, get_screen, list_app_screens, list_flows, list_my_boards, list_ui_elements, search_apps, and search_screens.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Appllama?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Appllama in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Appllama requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Appllama is developed by Appllama. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
